Why is Lamine Yamal wearing No. 10 jersey for Spain against England in UEFA Nations League?
 This is not the first time Yamal will wear the No. 10 for Spain. He did it in 2024 against Denmark during the UEFA Nations League.

 Spain forward Lamine Yamal on Sunday will wear a No. 10 jersey when his team takes on England in the UEFA Nations League at the Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid.
 The 19-year-old is the No. 10 at his club FC Barcelona, but usually wears the No. 19 jersey with La Furia Roja .
 ALSO READ: Portugal vs Denmark player ratings — Seleção das Quinas lose 1-4 after retirement of Cristiano Ronaldo 
 However, he will be changing his number for Monday’s clash owing to an injury to Dani Olmo, Spain’s designated No. 10.
 According to UEFA’s rules, no jersey number can be left unoccupied i.e. the national team has to have sequential numbers without a gap in between while playing UEFA competitions like the Nations League.
 Olmo is injured for this international window and was not called up to his national team, thus prompting the change. Liverpool winger Victor Munoz will switch to No. 19 for this game.
 This is not the first time Yamal will wear the No. 10 for Spain, having done so for the same reason in 2024.
